headline.text: L3 ML1 filter lid handle unaccounted for — *metal component* lost during shift, location unknown.

summary: One open foreign-material investigation: missing metal handle from L3 ML1 Imperial filter lid discovered during inspection. Two process gaps surfaced today: line-clearance failure at L3 ML1 (labels/boxes found on line after changeover) and cleaning verification gap at L2 ML3 (vacuum clogged from inadequate filter maintenance).

food_safety.title: Missing filter lid handle on Imperial depositor
food_safety.summary: Operator discovered metal handle missing from Imperial filter lid during inspection; handle not located, potential foreign material risk in production area.
food_safety.status: Open, no follow-up investigation or product hold visible in window.

food_safety.title: Bent cutter folders on S4 line
food_safety.summary: Cutter end folder #2 reported bent; damaged metal component in food-contact zone poses foreign material risk if pieces detach.
food_safety.status: Open, no investigation or maintenance follow-up visible in window.

quality.title: Labels and boxes found on ML1 line
quality.summary: Loose labels and labeled boxes discovered on line during shift; line-clearance failure after changeover or prior run.
quality.status: Open, material reported but no disposition or corrective action visible.

sanitation.title: ML3 vacuum clogged from cleaning gap
sanitation.summary: Vacuum down 49 minutes due to considerable chocolate buildup; supervisor attributed to insufficient filter cleaning frequency and improper use of water on pleated filters.
sanitation.status: Resolved — line restarted at 06:48 after clearing; root cause identified as cleaning process gap.

opportunities.text: Add S4 cutter folder condition check to pre-run or maintenance rounds — based on today's bent folder #2 with no visible investigation protocol.

Review ML3 vacuum filter cleaning frequency and add pleated-filter care (dry cleaning only) to operator training — based on today's 49-minute clog attributed to insufficient cleaning and water damage.
Consider adding filter hardware integrity check (handles, clips, fasteners) to ML1 Imperial pre-startup inspection — based on today's missing handle discovered mid-shift.
Reinforce line-clearance verification and shadow-board discipline at ML1 changeover — based on labels and boxes found on line during today's shift.
